jobs.instructions: Record baseline, evidence, units, falsifier and limits. Check simulation output and Lean assumptions. Treat biology topics as non-operational educational explanations.
Write original character dialogue and mark technical claims with evidence IDs. Preserve established personalities and pronunciation.
Describe framing, blocking, duration and continuity per shot. Reuse the outgoing frame when the director calls for a match.
Resolve pacing, screen geography, character continuity, palette and look. Approve the shot list before image, voice and animation work.
Deliver original images, faces, costume references and texture assets with source IDs. Preserve character landmarks across shots.
Assign each speaker an approved synthetic voice profile. Render dialogue and time both cue points and captions.
Build shots from reviewed assets, render frame ranges, and preserve CAD and simulation inputs. Record the Blender version and render settings.
Cut picture with dialogue, synchronize captions, validate stream specs and prepare separately resumable chapters.

Watch the edit and score writing, animation and on-screen UI independently. Record failed shots and recheck the revision. Each score must exceed eight out of ten and all technical claims must be accurate.
